name: Water, liquid (H2O)
source: H2O molar mass 18.015 g/mol from IUPAC standard atomic weights (H 1.008 x2, O 15.999). H fraction 2.016/18.015 = 11.19067%.
notes: Potable/process water treated as pure H2O; dissolved minerals are negligible at bakery scale and are not tracked separately here. O closes the two-element compound exactly.
